stem: A room has scattered yellowing, but the pattern is strongest on one irrigation zone and began after a maintenance event. Which technician handoff is strongest?
choices: A mapped description of affected plants, onset timing, irrigation-zone relationship, maintenance history, and available measurements with the cause left unconfirmed
A request to change all nutrient targets immediately
A note that the crop looks bad
rationale: A strong handoff preserves observable pattern, timing, system context, and measurements while separating evidence from diagnosis.
